item.description: As the US bombed Islamist militants in Nigeria on Christmas Day, the actions of Bangladeshis against people of a religious minority led to a second death and incidents of intimidation of people celebrating Christmas in India took place in many states, it did lend credence to the view that religion tends to promote hate and violence
